name: 💡 Feature Request / Creative Idea

### ✨ Describe Your Festive Idea
A clear and concise description of what feature, mini-game, cracker, or decoration you would love to see.

### 🎮 How will it work in the 3D World?
Explain how the player will interact with this feature (e.g. keybindings, touch gestures, dialogue, or visual effect).

### 🌟 Why will this make the Diwali celebration more awesome?
Share why this feature will bring joy to the community.

### 🛠️ Would you like to code this feature yourself?
- [ ] Yes! I would love to build this and submit a Pull Request.
- [ ] No, but I wanted to share this idea for other contributors to build.
